title: Can AI interview? Comparing AI-led to Human-led Chat Interviews
abstract: arXiv:2610.23149v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model chatbots have been proposed as AI-interviewers for collecting qualitative interview data at scale, potentially bridging social science's longstanding divide between the breadth of surveys and the depth of qualitative interviews. This paper provides the first direct empirical comparison of data quality in AI-led and human-led interviews. In a randomized experiment (N = 41), university students were interviewed via synchronous text chat by either trained non-expert interviewers or a locally hosted AI system; we evaluate exposure, specificity, and relevance. Median interview duration was similar across conditions, but AI-interviewers asked more than twice as many questions per interview and elicited roughly 65 percent more respondent text per interview. translated_title: AI能进行访谈吗？AI主导与人类主导的聊天访谈对比
translated_abstract: 大语言模型聊天机器人已被提议作为“AI访谈者”，用于大规模收集定性访谈数据，这有望弥合社会科学长期存在的问卷调查广度与定性访谈深度之间的鸿沟。本文首次对AI主导访谈与人类主导访谈的数据质量进行了直接的实证比较。在一项随机实验（N = 41）中，大学生通过同步文本聊天接受访谈，访谈者要么是受过训练的非专业访谈员，要么是本地托管的AI系统；我们评估了曝光度、具体性和相关性三个维度。两种条件下的访谈时长中位数相近，但AI访谈者每次访谈提出的问题数量是人类的两倍多，且每次访谈引出的受访者文本量多出约65%。人类访谈者条件下，针对每个问题的回答更长，但在经过多重检验校正后这一差异不再显著；只有AI条件下的参与者出现了跳过问题的情况。
tldr: 本文首次通过随机对照实验直接比较了AI主导与人类主导的聊天访谈数据质量，发现AI访谈者在访谈时长相当的情况下提问数量是人类的两倍多，并能引出多出约65%的受访者文本。
en_tdlr: This paper provides the first direct empirical comparison of AI-led versus human-led chat interviews, showing that AI interviewers ask more than twice as many questions and elicit roughly 65% more respondent text per interview, with similar interview duration.
